RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Not reliably estimable from these facts

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex bias. Assigning a percentage would imply knowledge we don’t have.

Your qualifications are strong, but a head-of-function role may prioritize leadership, regulatory judgment, and stakeholder management alongside technical expertise. An announcement isn’t a full account of the successful candidate’s qualifications.

Follow up now on your unanswered request. Ask for the selection criteria, how your application was assessed, and feedback on the decision—not an explanation of the panel’s sex composition.

If you uncover sex-related remarks, inconsistent criteria, or unequal treatment, consider a formal complaint or legal advice. Check local deadlines promptly if contemplating a discrimination claim.
